data.title: Bind every shared-overlay build path and fix perf ACK framing
data.description: Completes the strategy change by placing all raw-byte shared-overlay SHA-256 pins in one overlay_pins.py module and enforcing them in every semantic consumer: prepare_overlays A/B/C/D staging, current build_children children/pristine/hooked injection and manifest generation, and prepare_children snapshot capture. Current evidence input topology now binds overlay_pins.py itself. Fragment/control-flow checks remain diagnostic only. The runtime fix consumes exact ack LF NUL frames, preserves the ack-LF ledger, and emits perf_disable canonically. Real and hostile injection/capture smokes, all suites, cargo/fmt checks, and real perf/strace rehearsals pass.
